$description: Shokunin Crafthouse · Primitives · raw token values · single source of truth. Generated from Figma Primitives collection (VariableCollectionId:2013:2). Anchors marked in token descriptions are the values extracted directly from stages/02-design/design-system-preview.html; non-anchored values are derived (palette interpolation, alpha steps, etc.) and called out per-token.

$metadata.spacingBase: Hybrid 4/8pt layout ladder + 2pt micro ladder. Layout: 4·8·12·16·24·32·48·64·80·96·120 px. Micro (chrome only): 2·6·10·14·18·22 px. Arbitrary px outside these ladders is a bug.
$metadata.fontStrategy: scds-v2: THREE families. Display = Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro (headings + section/subheads; weights 250/300/400/500/700/900 self-hosted; 95 Black/900 carries the headline register — thin→Black retires thin headers). Text = Neue Haas Grotesk Text Pro (body + chrome labels; 400/500/700). Mono = Cascadia Mono (Google Fonts CDN) — reduced to ~10% of surfaces: hex values / token names / code ONLY, dropped from chrome labels. family.sans kept as a back-compat alias. Heading weights: card title 24=bold(700), section title 32 + display 44/60/84/120 = black(900); body stays Text Regular(400); chrome labels Text Medium(500); weight 600 carries mono token-references + the secondary-button hover bump. Per-step composition tokens at font.text.{step} bind size + weight + lineHeight + tracking + family; surfaces reach for those. line-height + tracking kept canonical across the weight change. Full rationale in _config/design-system/type-system.md (re-sync pending). Mono re-affirmed Sprint 2 (Cascadia / Geist / JetBrains / IBM Plex) — see decisions/decisions.md.

25.$description: Floating surface (popovers, interactive-card hover top layer). scds-v2: desaturated toward HSB(30,3,B) — warm hue kept, saturation pulled to ~3%. Was #F8F6F2.

50.$description: Raised / component surface — default card ground in light. scds-v2 desaturate HSB(30,3,96). Was #F1EFEB.

100.$description: Page ground · light. scds-v2 desaturate HSB(30,3,92) — heavily desaturated warm, retires the saturated oatmeal. Was #E3DFD8.

200.$description: Set-in component surface · cards, frames, raised tiles. scds-v2 desaturate HSB(30,3,85). Was #D9D5CE.

250.$description: Default hairline rule · 1px solid divisions (light). scds-v2 desaturate HSB(30,3,84). Was #D5D1CA.

300.$description: Sunk surface · form inputs, card hover, nested states. scds-v2 desaturate HSB(30,3,80). Was #CDC9C2.

350.$description: Subtle hairline · dashed inner divisions. scds-v2 desaturate HSB(30,3,77). Was #C5C0B8.

400.$description: Faint warm gray · disabled text and decorative marks (fails AA by spec). Text-tier — kept warm per scds-v2 (surfaces desaturate, ink/text stay warm).

450.$description: Tertiary text · light. scds-v2 addition — AA on page/raised/floating (4.63/5.06/5.42:1); restricted off sunk/deepSunk like text.secondary. Mirrors the dark tertiary tier (dark.textTertiary). Text-tier, kept warm.

500.$description: Muted warm gray · secondary copy, metadata. Text-tier — kept warm per scds-v2.

600.$description: Mid-deep · derived between 500 and 800. Reserved for future deep-mid surfaces.

700.$description: Near-ink · derived between 500 and 800. Reserved for future near-ink surfaces.

800.$description: Ink · anchor from HTML --ink. Primary text, strong rules.

900.$description: Bar deep · light-mode deep bar / colophon. NOTE: no longer the dark-mode ground — scds-v2 retired the warm dark theme; dark grounds now live under color.dark.* (true neutral).

50.$description: Lightest teal wash · derived. For soft accent backgrounds.

100.$description: Pale teal · derived. Soft accent fills.

200.$description: Light teal · derived. Accent surface tints.

300.$description: Mid-light teal · derived. Used for dark-mode interactive states.

400.$description: Mid teal · derived. Dark-mode hover/active accent color (5.84:1 on dark.surfacePage).

500.$description: Teal · anchor (owner-specified brand color, 2026-07-09 rebrand). The single chromatic accent. Replaces the retired vermilion shu scale.

600.$description: Mid-deep teal · derived. Text-bearing accent fill: white text passes AA at 5.20:1 (500 fails at 3.97, teal is lighter than the old vermilion). Routed via semantic brand.accentFill.

700.$description: Deep teal · derived. Pressed/active accent; AA-passing accent text on light surfaces (5.78:1 on warmGray.100).

800.$description: Deeper teal · derived. Future high-contrast accent uses.

light.$description: Forest green · success states on light ground. AA ~4.9:1 on warmGray.100. Repainted 2026-05-28 to match brand-site Color design (ADR brand-site-shell).

dark.$description: Lifted green · success states on dark ground.

light.$description: Burnt orange · warning states on light ground · hue ~20°. Repainted 2026-05-28 to match brand-site Color design (ADR brand-site-shell).

dark.$description: Lifted orange · warning states on dark ground.

light.$description: Royal blue · info states on light ground · AA ~7.5:1 on warmGray.100. Repainted 2026-05-28 to match brand-site Color design (ADR brand-site-shell).

dark.$description: Lifted blue · info states on dark ground.

light.$description: Oxblood · error states on light ground · deep + serious, pulled deliberately off the brand band so brand-accent and danger can never be confused. Added 2026-05-28 (ADR brand-site-shell).

dark.$description: Lifted rose · error states on dark ground. 2026-07-25 SCDS audit P0-4: was #732020 (1.79:1, unreadable — inverted the light→dark lift every peer status hue follows). #DD4C4C measures 4.76:1 on dark.surfacePage, alongside success/dark's 4.82 (the peer band). Hue held at 0° (14.2° separation from warning/dark, max available). Fixed in Figma 2026-07-25 (VariableID:2:52); this is the code-side propagation (audit 8.8).

signal.$description: Standalone signal hues (2026-07-23 portal redesign). live is a broadcast/recording signal — deliberately red, off the brand band (learning #39) and distinct from status.error; the retired vermilion pair returns as a SIGNAL, not brand accent (the 2026-07-09 rebrand retired it from the brand tier only). progress is the chartreuse attention hue for in-progress/active states and live indicators.

dark.$description: Dark-mode ground ladder · scds-v2 TRUE NEUTRAL (equal RGB on the ladder steps). Retires the warm-brown dark theme that matched slop-blocklist 'warm neutral ground + vermilion'. Elevation model (Phase 2): component sinks BELOW page (well), hover rises to page level. ⚠ Gate-2 on-device check: pure-neutral near-blacks drift on wide-gamut Chrome (p3-near-black-drift-chrome) — verify on a P3 display; if they cast, apply a +1 red whisper at the darkest steps. well already carries a faint warm whisper (#080807).

well.$description: Deepest component well · resting component ground in dark (component sinks below page). Faint +1 warm whisper baked at the floor.

floor.$description: Floor · one step above the well. Rail / deepest nested fill above the component well. True neutral.

surfacePage.$description: Page ground · dark. True neutral. Component hover rises to this level (reads flush with page on hover).

raised1.$description: Raised step 1 · lifts above page (cards/raised that read elevated in dark via lighter fill). True neutral.

raised2.$description: Raised step 2 · floating / popover ground in dark. True neutral.

raised3.$description: Raised step 3 · highest interactive fills. True neutral.

raised4.$description: Raised step 4 · default divider-grade fill / strong-ish separators. True neutral.

raised5.$description: Raised step 5 · strongest neutral fill before text tiers. True neutral.

border.$description: Dark-mode default border / structural separator. Neutral (was warm #201E1A). Content separators now prefer the divider scale (color.divider.*).

borderSubtle.$description: Dark-mode subtle border · closer to page than default = less visible. Neutral (was warm #2F2B26).

textPrimary.$description: Dark-mode primary text · 17–18:1 on page/well. scds-v2 (was warm #E2DDD6).

textSecondary.$description: Dark-mode secondary text · 8.9–10.2:1 on dark grounds (AAA). scds-v2 addition (dark secondary previously aliased warmGray.400).

textTertiary.$description: Dark-mode tertiary text · AA on page/well (4.58/4.79:1); restricted off the lighter raised surfaces (4.40:1 on raised1 < AA). scds-v2 addition.

textDisabled.$description: Dark-mode disabled text · derived (fails AA by spec). scds-v2 (was warm #6B655C).

white.$description: Pure white · utility primitive. Used by semantic text-on-accent and accent fill text.

black.$description: Pure black · utility primitive. Reserved for special shadow alpha bases.

whiteRgb.$description: Channel triplet (sRGB, space-separated) for rgb()/rgba() alpha composition — channel-triplet-rgba-tokens. Pairs with utility.white. Consumed by the dark divider scale: rgb(var(--sc-p-color-white-rgb) / <alpha>). Emitted verbatim by the build (color passthrough).

inkRgb.$description: Channel triplet (sRGB) of warmGray.800 ink (#1A1815) for rgb()/rgba() composition. Consumed by the light divider scale: rgb(var(--sc-p-color-ink-rgb) / <alpha>).

focusRing.$description: Dedicated focus-ring color · OFF the brand (teal) band and off every status hue — focus-ring-token. Cool-neutral, AA+++ on every ground its mode touches. Replaces routing :focus through the old vermilion accent.

light.$description: Focus ring · light mode. Cool near-ink. 11–15:1 on every light ground (page 13.24, raised 14.45, floating 15.49, sunk 11.24).

dark.$description: Focus ring · dark mode. Cool near-white. 14–16:1 on every dark ground (page 15.67, well 16.37, raised 15.06, floating 14.22).

sans.$description: Legacy combined sans stack · kept for back-compat. scds-v2 splits this into family.display (headings) + family.text (body/chrome); new surfaces should reach for those. Self-hosted woff2 from /fonts/.

display.$description: Display cut · headings + section/subheads. scds-v2 extends Display below the hero (section + card titles). Self-hosted weights 250/300/400/500/700/900; the 95 Black (900) carries the headline register (retires thin headers).

text.$description: Text cut · body + chrome labels. NHG Text Pro 400/500/700 self-hosted. Body stays Text Regular (400) per scds-v2; chrome labels use Text Medium (500), no longer mono.

mono.$description: Monospace · scds-v2 reduced to ~10% of surfaces: hex values, token names, code ONLY. Dropped from chrome labels (eyebrows/badges/buttons → family.text). Loaded from Google Fonts CDN. Selected over Geist/JetBrains/Plex — see decisions/decisions.md 2026-05-26.

11.$description: 11px · type scale step (modular ratio 1.25). UI eyebrows, badges, buttons.

13.$description: 13px · type scale step. Captions, muted secondary copy.

14.$description: 14px · type scale step. Secondary body copy.

16.$description: 16px · type scale step. Body copy default.

offscale.$description: OFFSCALE · sizes deliberately off the 1.25 modular ladder. Editorial one-offs used only on the brand-site Color page — NOT general-use. Added 2026-05-28 (ADR brand-site-shell type pass).

thin.$description: Thin · 250. Display weight for font.text.44 (display/sm) per Figma Color page. Active weight set widened 2026-05-31 (ADR brand-site-shell type recheck).

light.$description: Light · 300. Display weight for premise statements and large headlines.

medium.$description: Medium · 500. UI labels, button text, section titles, eyebrows.

semibold.$description: Semibold · 600. Mono token-reference labels (font.text.mono.11) and the secondary-button hover bump. Restriction widened 2026-05-28 to match Figma Color page mono/chrome — see decisions/decisions.md (brand-site-shell type pass).

bold.$description: Bold · 700. NHG 75 Bold. scds-v2 subhead tier — card titles (font.text.24) join the Display register one step below section heads.

black.$description: Black · 900. NHG Display 95 Black. scds-v2 headline + section register (thin→Black, retires thin headers). @font-face added in src/styles/fonts.css.

flat.$description: Flat · 1.0. Display specimens at 120px, vertical alignment.

relaxed.$description: Relaxed · 1.55. Long-read prose, captions in cards.

wider.$description: Wider · 0.06em. Mono caps at 11px in chrome.

caps.$description: Caps · 0.1em. Premium small caps treatment for sub-sections.

text.$description: Composed typography tokens · one per scale step. Resolves family + size + weight + lineHeight + tracking for the default register at that step. Surfaces SHOULD reach for these instead of the underlying primitives unless a single axis is deliberately overridden (e.g. set 32px in mono — override family, keep the rest). Full weight + optical rationale lives in _config/design-system/type-system.md. Sprint 2 deliverable resolving 2a.

11.$description: Chrome eyebrows, badges, button labels. Medium-weight optical compensation for NHG sub-pixel rendering at 11px; widest tracking sets chrome rhythm.

12.$description: UI labels, dense table headers. Same chrome-tier compensation as step 11; wide tracking (less than widest) because 12px holds rhythm with less air.

13.$description: Captions, muted secondary copy. Transitions out of chrome register into body register; regular weight + relaxed leading for reading-length captions.

14.$description: Secondary body, dense table cells, form helper text.

16.$description: Body default. Anchor of the weight rhythm — every other step calibrates against 16/400/1.5/0.

20.$description: Lead paragraph, intro body, large body. Regular preserves reading-text register one step above body.

24.$description: Card titles, mid-headlines. First step into headline register.

32.$description: Section titles, page headers. Section-marker weight; tight tracking separates from prose mass.

44.$description: Premise statements, hero subhead. Crosses into display register — NHG Light carries open counters; tighter tracking closes the rhythm so light doesn't read loose.

84.$description: Large display, hero primary. At this size, regular reads as bold — light is the considered weight.

120.$description: Maximum display, hero monumental. Flat 1.0 line-height for vertical alignment in two-line displays.

mono.$description: Mono variants · chrome tier only. Mono is not a default at headline or display sizes — invoke as a single-axis family override on the sans composition tokens if a larger mono surface is required.

11.$description: Mono caps in chrome at 11px. tracking.wider (0.06em) not widest (0.08em) — at this scale Cascadia caps loosen unevenly under widest with NHG.

13.$description: Mono captions, token references, timestamps at 13px.

14.$description: Mono inline code, dense mono cells at 14px.

16.$description: Mono code block body. Use Cascadia Code companion for ligatures inside <code>/<pre> surfaces.

offscale.$description: OFFSCALE · type compositions off the modular scale. Brand-site Color page only — NOT general-use. Added 2026-05-28 (ADR brand-site-shell type pass).

18.$description: OFFSCALE · 18px chapter premise on the Color page.

22.$description: OFFSCALE · 22px hero lead on the Color page.

200.$description: OFFSCALE · 200px accent plate glyph on the Color page.

2.$description: 2px · chrome micro-spacing (2pt ladder). Component padding, badge insets, mono caps compensation.

none.$description: No radius. Reserved for special structural rectangles.

input.$description: Form input + badge radius. Small, just enough to read as soft.

default.$description: Default radius. Cards, buttons, frames, stamps.

circle.$description: Pill / full circle. Status dots, brand stamp.

hairline.$description: 1px · default rule weight. Card borders, Divider, Input border, NavBar underline. Sprint 4 addition.

focus.$description: 2px · focus-ring outline weight. Stronger than hairline so focus state reads at distance. Sprint 4 addition.

accent.$description: 3px · accent rule. Alert left-rule, ProgressIndicator bar thickness. Sprint 4 addition.

orchestrated.$description: 720ms · page, route, choreographed reveal. Justify anything longer in writing.

out.$description: Quint-out · primary easing. Hover, state changes, most things that ease in or out.

outStrong.$description: Strong quint-out · press/release. From levibahn.com convention.

springOut.$description: Overshoot release · CSS approximation of the studio tap-scale spring (Drams press-spring, 2026-07-23). Interactive release phase only.

cinematic.$description: Long deliberate · orchestrated only. Page transitions.

pressButton.$description: Button press scale · 0.985. Subtle confirmation press (levibahn.com).

pressTap.$description: Tap target press scale · 0.92. Heavier touch affordance.
